source_name: NBS – Legislatíva (dohľad nad finančným trhom), searchable legislative document register
why_relevant: Central searchable register of NBS national legal acts: zákony, vyhlášky, opatrenia, metodické usmernenia, rozhodnutia, odporúčania. Page exposes a filter tool with fields for document name/number, year, regulatory area (oblasť regulácie) and document type — i.e. it is machine-navigable for systematic harvesting of every SK banking/payments regulatory instrument.

source_name: NBS – Legislatíva hub (dohľad nad finančným trhom)
why_relevant: Top-level pointer that enumerates every NBS legal/supervisory publication stream: národná legislatíva, právo EÚ, dohody o spolupráci, sprievodca právnymi predpismi, materiály na pripomienkové konanie, materiály na konzultáciu, usmernenia európskych orgánov dohľadu prijaté NBS. Best single entry point for mapping the whole A3 surface and for snowballing new sub-portals.

source_name: NBS – Metodické usmernenia a stanoviská k AML/CFT (ochrana pred legalizáciou príjmov z trestnej činnosti)
why_relevant: Topic-scoped landing page collecting NBS AML/CFT guidance and opinions for banks and payment/e-money institutions, including adoption of EBA guidelines. AML/CFT is the highest-friction compliance workstream for SK payment institutions and drives concrete deadlines.

source_name: NBS – Materiály na konzultáciu (consultation materials)
why_relevant: The pre-legislative early-warning channel: NBS publishes konzultačné materiály (e.g. intervention measures on CFDs and binary options) with a comment address and a fixed comment window (observed: 10 working days from publication). Gives lead time on rules before they are adopted, and reveals NBS policy intent.

source_name: NBS – Materiály na pripomienkové konanie za NBS (draft regulations open for comment)
why_relevant: Distinct from 'konzultácia': this is the formal Slovak pripomienkové konanie stream where NBS's own draft opatrenia/vyhlášky are exposed for comment. Earliest reliable signal of a forthcoming binding NBS act and its intended effective date.

source_name: NBS – Usmernenia európskych orgánov dohľadu prijaté NBS alebo Rezolučnou radou (EBA/ESMA/EIOPA guidelines adopted by NBS)
why_relevant: Records NBS's formal comply-or-explain adoption of EBA/ESMA guidelines — the mechanism by which EU-level payment/banking rules become SK supervisory expectations, with application dates. Essential for mapping EU deadlines onto the SK market.

source_name: Vestník NBS (Journal of Národná banka Slovenska)
why_relevant: The legally authoritative publication venue for NBS legal acts not published in the Zbierka zákonov. NBS explicitly states the only binding text for the public is the printed Vestník edition; the web page provides year-by-year archives 1993–2026. Definitive for citation and for confirming a measure's official number and date.

source_name: SLOV-LEX – Zbierka zákonov SR / chronologický register opatrení (NBS measures)
why_relevant: Government legal portal carrying NBS opatrenia both as Z.z. items and in a dedicated chronologický register opatrení with stable, guessable URL patterns (/SK/OP/<year>/<no>/vyhlasene_znenie.html and /SK/ZZ/<year>/<no>/). Provides consolidated wording, downloadable PDF/DOCX/ASiCE and the legislative process trail — a far more machine-friendly complement to nbs.sk for the binding text.

source_name: NBS – Dohľad: Platobné služby a elektronické peniaze (payment institutions, EMI, AISP)
why_relevant: The sector-specific supervisory hub for the payments vertical: licensing procedure (postup podania žiadosti) broken into individually addressable conditions (Podmienka A..Q), pre-application and post-application steps, and a licensing handbook PDF. This is where NBS states its actual supervisory benchmarks and expectations for PI/EMI/AISP applicants and incumbents.

source_name: NBS (EN) – Payment services and electronic money / Payment institutions and AISP
why_relevant: English mirror of the payments supervision hub. Useful for cross-checking terminology and for non-SK-reading analysts, but NBS states explicitly that only the Slovak texts in the Zbierka zákonov or Vestník NBS have legal force and that recent amendments may not yet be translated — so the EN tree lags and must not be the primary collection target.

source_name: NBS (EN) – Slovakia: legal acts and other documents / Laws within the NBS competence
why_relevant: Curated English list of the core SK financial-market statutes (Act No 483/2001 on banks, Act No 492/2009 on payment services, Act No 186/2009 on financial intermediation, etc.) with translations. Fastest way to build the statutory backbone/actor map for the cell; carries an explicit caveat that only the Slovak original has legal force.

source_name: NBS – Aktuality (news / regulator announcements feed)
why_relevant: Highest-velocity NBS channel. Carries consultation-opening notices, komuniké of Banková rada decisions, warnings about unauthorised entities, EBA guideline effective-date reminders, and supervisory statements — often days before the structured legislative register is updated. The site offers a notification subscription ('Prihlásenie na odber notifikácií').

source_name: NBS – Registre dohľadu / subjekty.nbs.sk (register of supervised entities)
why_relevant: Authoritative register of licensed banks, payment institutions, EMIs, AISPs, intermediaries and creditors; NBS's own FAQ directs the public to subjekty.nbs.sk to verify whether an entity is supervised and permitted to operate in SK. Backbone for the actor map and for detecting new market entrants/licence withdrawals — an indirect but reliable regulatory-action signal.

source_name: NBS – Metodická a sankčná činnosť (methodological and sanctioning activity)
why_relevant: Documents how NBS applies sanctions in practice, including the rozkaz o uložení sankcie fast-track for minor breaches (fines up to EUR 5,000 plus remedial measures). Enforcement patterns are the sharpest read on real supervisory priorities, beyond what the written rules say.

source_name: NBS – Informácie pre vykazujúce subjekty / IS STATUS-DFT reporting system
why_relevant: The operational compliance layer: NBS's reporting system for supervised entities (banks, PIs, EMIs), with all-participant guidance, electronic form definitions (DBVD DFT database) and onboarding/access procedures. Reporting obligations and their submission calendars are the single densest source of recurring regulatory deadlines, and changes to výkazy signal new supervisory data demands.

source_name: NBS – Makroprudenciálna politika: makroprudenciálny komentár a rozhodnutia Bankovej rady (CCyB, buffers)
why_relevant: Quarterly commentary plus the Banková rada decisions setting the proticyklický kapitálový vankúš and other buffers. Macroprudential decisions are binding on SK banks, carry explicit application dates, and are published on a predictable quarterly cadence — high-value for a regulatory deadline calendar. NBS exercises macroprudential powers as part of financial market supervision.

source_name: NBS – Správa o činnosti útvaru dohľadu nad finančným trhom (annual supervision activity report)
why_relevant: Annual retrospective on what NBS actually did: inspections carried out, sanctions imposed, licensing volumes, thematic priorities. Converts scattered individual acts into measurable supervisory-intensity trends, and often previews next-year priorities. Available for a long back-run (2019–2024+), also in EN.

source_name: NBS – Inovačný hub a regulačný sandbox (FinTech innovation facilitators)
why_relevant: NBS's regulatory-dialogue channel for fintech and payments innovation (Inovačný hub since 2019, regulačný sandbox since early 2022), with an annual report on hub/sandbox activity. Reveals NBS's stance on emerging payment business models before any formal rule exists, and which innovation themes are under supervisory examination.

source_name: NBS – Dohľad kryptoaktív (MiCA) a Digitálna prevádzková odolnosť / Register informácií (DORA)
why_relevant: The two newest supervisory workstreams touching banks and payment firms: MiCA crypto-asset licensing/supervision and DORA's Register informácií (ICT third-party register) with hard submission deadlines. High deadline density and high relevance to payments-technology vendors.

source_name: NBS – Dear CEO letters / supervisory communications to payment service providers
why_relevant: Direct supervisory correspondence addressed to boards of payment-services firms — an unusually candid statement of NBS's supervisory expectations and concerns, of a kind rarely captured in formal legal registers. Found on the legacy www.nbs.sk document tree, which suggests such letters may not be systematically indexed on the new site.

source_name: Legacy NBS site (www.nbs.sk) – pre-migration document and news archive
why_relevant: NBS migrated to a new information architecture (nbs.sk/...) but a large legacy corpus remains addressable at www.nbs.sk/sk/... and www.nbs.sk/_img/documents/..., including older supervisory news, macroprudential commentaries and consultation evaluations. Necessary for historical depth and for recovering documents whose new-site links 404.

source_name: NBS – Nahlasovanie porušení (whistleblowing channel)
why_relevant: Reveals-indirectly source: the existence, scope and stated handling procedure of NBS's breach-reporting channel documents which breach categories NBS treats as actionable, and is a structural input into future enforcement. Low content volume but useful for completing the supervisory-process map.

source_name: NBS – Sprievodca právnymi predpismi (guide to legal instrument types)
why_relevant: NBS's own taxonomy of document types and their binding force under EU and national law. This is the schema authority for classifying harvested documents (opatrenie vs metodické usmernenie vs odporúčanie vs stanovisko vs rozhodnutie) — indispensable for building a correct ontology rather than guessing.

source_name: NBS – Materiály NBS v pripomienkovom konaní (NBS materials in comment procedure)
why_relevant: Central register of NBS draft measures (opatrenia) currently open for comments, listing the slov-lex LP number, publication date and comment deadline in a table (e.g. LP/2026/421 banking reporting amendment, deadline 25.8.2026; LP/2026/437 register of financial agents, deadline 8.9.2026). This is the single earliest, most actionable structured feed of NBS regulatory deadlines for the SK banking/payments sector.

source_name: NBS – Konzultačné materiály (consultation materials, financial consumer protection)
why_relevant: NBS supervisory-department consultation papers addressed to the professional public, each with an explicit submission deadline (e.g. 'Posudzovanie schopnosti spotrebiteľa splácať úver', published 2.10.2025, deadline 7.11.2025). Signals supervisory expectations before they harden into measures. Low volume but very high signal; long gaps between entries (2015 then 2025).

source_name: SLOV-LEX – Legislatívne procesy (inter-ministerial comment procedure, MPK)
why_relevant: The statutory national portal where every MF SR and NBS draft law/measure enters medzirezortné pripomienkové konanie with an LP/{year}/{number} identifier, full document set, start and end date of the comment period, and all submitted comments (including bank and SBA comments) with the submitter's identity. The authoritative primary record for consultation deadlines and who is lobbying what.

source_name: SLOV-LEX – Predbežná informácia (pre-legislative early notice)
why_relevant: Earliest possible signal in the SK pipeline: ministries must publish a 'predbežná informácia' about a planned law with a short (typically ~15-day) window for suggestions, months before the draft text and MPK. For banking/payments this reveals intent to transpose EU acts (PSD3/PSR, MiCA-related, CRD/CRR) before any text exists.

source_name: NBS – Vestník NBS (official journal, yearly issues)
why_relevant: Terminal end of the consultation pipeline: the issued measure with its number and effective date (účinnosť), which is the compliance deadline banks and PSPs must hit. Pairing Vestník entries with the earlier MPK record gives measured lead time from consultation to compliance.

source_name: NBS – Legislatíva / detail dokumentu (measures repository, dohľad nad finančným trhom)
why_relevant: Per-measure detail pages for adopted opatrenia (e.g. opatrenie 6/2025 on reporting consumer-credit data; opatrenie 7/2024 amending 4/2015 on risk-management systems). Gives the canonical text and dates a consultation ended in, and the reference numbers to link back to LP entries.
